title: A smaller text model catalog
summary:
A catalog cleanup, a new community listing, and a Python example that matches the SDK.

Removed llamalight, llama-vision, llama-scaleway, and pixtral from the text model list. Mistral remains listed for text-and-image input.

Added @ayick13’s Indonesian-language Generator Text AI to the project directory and moved @Aashir__Shaikh’s VibeCoder into Tools & Interfaces. VibeCoder itself and its links are unchanged.

Updated the website example to create a `pollinations.Image` with the selected model and image settings, then call `Generate(prompt=..., save=True)`.
